sentences.text: Néstor Gastón Carbonell -LRB- -LSB- ˈnestor ɣasˈtoŋ karβoˈneʎ -RSB- ; born December 1 , 1967 -RRB- is an American actor .

He is perhaps most famous for his roles as Richard Alpert in ABC 's drama series Lost , and Mayor Anthony Garcia in the Christopher Nolan films The Dark Knight and The Dark Knight Rises .
